title: Output rule payload
description: Post-execution output safety scan. Match scopes by topic/tool/risk and finding types; decide narrows the unified DecisionType to outcomes meaningful for output (allow/deny/redact/quarantine/require_human).

type.description: Discriminator for a Rule's match/decide payload schema.

scope.description:
Narrows where a rule (or bundle) applies. When `kind` is `global`,
`value` is unused and may be empty; for the other kinds, `value`
carries the corresponding identifier (tenant id, workflow id, edge
fleet name, edge user id).

status.description:
Lifecycle state of a Rule. `draft` rules are author-only; `published`
rules participate in evaluation; `deprecated` rules remain queryable
for audit and rollback but are skipped by evaluators.

audit.description:
Records who created or last updated a Rule or Bundle. The `updated_*`
fields are zero-valued on first creation and populated by the first
subsequent edit.

tools.description: Tool names whose output is scanned by this rule.

risk_tags.description: Required risk tags on the job context.

finding_types.description: Output scanner finding types this rule reacts to.

redact_strategy.description: Optional strategy hint passed to the output redactor (e.g. `mask`, `tokenize`).
